links.outcome: Readability (SMOG) of chatbot answers to orthognathic surgery patient questions
links.effect: All three chatbots required at least a college-level education for readability based on the SMOG index; OpenEvidence had the highest SMOG values.
links.quote: When evaluated in terms of reliability and quality, all three AI-based chatbots demonstrated high reliability and good quality; however, they required at least a college-level education for readability based on the SMOG index.

screen.reason: Evaluates the performance, readability, and reliability of different commercial AI chatbots answering orthognathic surgery questions using standardized rubrics without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
